signals_info.description: Signed lateral displacement from the lane center.

time_info.description: Bounded offset-satisfaction window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 2 seconds, the lane offset shall be greater than -0.3 meters and less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 2 秒内，车道横向偏移应至少有一个时刻大于 -0.3 米且小于 0.3 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 2-second window including now, the lateral offset magnitude shall be strictly less than 0.3 meters at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 2 秒窗口内，横向偏移绝对值应至少有一个时刻严格小于 0.3 米。
